ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels to 35% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous regions (lobes) bisected by a low-intensity black vertical band at the notch. Left lobe contains one isolated low-intensity circular spot; right lobe contains a vertical series of four distinct low-intensity circular spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 5-15 pixels along the distal trailing margins, most pronounced at the outer lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a jagged, slightly concave sweep from the distal tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized low-intensity circular pixel clusters detected: one on the medial-left lobe and a vertical alignment of four on the medial-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple circular dark spots potentially representing parasitic attachment sites; irregular jagged profile on the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical linear arrangement of four dark circular spots on the right fluke lobe.
